```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-coordcube-backend-comparison
#| fig-cap: "CoordCube on different backends: same query, same cost"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

backends = ['CoordKV2 (dense)\nr=1', 'CoordKVN (tree)\nr=1', 'CoordKV2 (dense)\nr=2', 'CoordKVN (tree)\nr=2', 'DynCoordKV\nr=1', 'DynCoordKV\nr=2']
latency = [282, 285, 666, 626, 161, 290]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))
bars = ax.bar(backends, latency, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='///')
ax.set_ylabel('Query latency (ns)')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(backends)))
ax.set_xticklabels(backends, fontsize=7)
for bar, val in zip(bars, latency):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 8, f'{val}', ha='center', fontsize=7)
ax.annotate('Dense vs tree:\nidentical\n(Vec push dominates)', xy=(0.5, 500), fontsize=8, ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.85))
ax.annotate('DynCoordKV\n1.6x faster\nthan sequential', xy=(4.5, 200), fontsize=8, ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.85))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```
